ConditionType.description:
Types of loan conditions -- copied verbatim from cre_underwriting.

Byte-sourced PTC (Prior to Closing) / PTF (Prior to Funding) condition
buckets map onto PRIOR_TO_CLOSING/PRIOR_TO_FUNDING directly.
ConditionType.title: ConditionType

LoanCondition.description:
Individual loan condition -- base shape copied verbatim from cre_underwriting, extended
with the citation ABA §5.9 requires (no Decision without policy_refs/evidence_refs/trace_id/
produced_by): rule_id and policy_refs are required, not defaulted, so a condition cannot be
constructed without naming what it violated. cell_key/cell_value are set only for a
matrix-derived violation (an expression/ratio violation has no single resolved cell).

rule_id.description: The eligibility rule_id this condition cites
rule_id.title: Rule Id

policy_refs.description: source_refs ref_id(s) the cited rule implements
policy_refs.title: Policy Refs

cell_key.description: Resolved matrix cell key, if the rule was a MatrixCondition
cell_key.title: Cell Key

cell_value.description: Resolved matrix cell value, if the rule was a MatrixCondition (numeric, or 'NA')
cell_value.title: Cell Value
